1.name: Basic
1.description: Understands fundamental concepts and terminology but requires guidance to perform tasks.

2.name: Developing
2.description: Can perform common tasks with some guidance and understands standard practices.

3.name: Proficient
3.description: Can independently perform expected tasks using appropriate methods and tools.

4.name: Advanced
4.description: Can handle complex tasks, troubleshoot problems, optimize solutions, and make technical decisions.

roles.description: Develops, tests, maintains, and improves software applications.

competencies.name: Programming
competencies.description: Ability to write, understand, debug, and maintain software code.

sub_competencies.name: Programming Fundamentals
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding variables, data types, operators, control flow, functions, and basic program structure.

sub_competencies.name: Object-Oriented Programming
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to use classes, objects, inheritance, abstraction, encapsulation, and polymorphism.

sub_competencies.name: Data Structures
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to select and use appropriate data structures such as arrays, lists, stacks, queues, trees, and hash tables.

sub_competencies.name: Algorithms
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to design, understand, and apply algorithms to solve computational problems efficiently.

sub_competencies.name: Debugging
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to identify, diagnose, and fix errors and unexpected behavior in software.

competencies.name: Software Design
competencies.description: Ability to design software components and systems that are maintainable and scalable.

sub_competencies.name: Design Principles
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding and application of principles such as modularity, separation of concerns, and SOLID principles.

sub_competencies.name: Design Patterns
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to recognize and apply common software design patterns appropriately.

sub_competencies.name: Code Maintainability
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to produce readable, reusable, modular, and maintainable code.

competencies.name: Software Testing
competencies.description: Ability to verify software correctness, reliability, and expected behavior.

sub_competencies.name: Unit Testing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to test individual functions or components independently.

sub_competencies.name: Integration Testing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to verify that multiple software components work correctly together.

sub_competencies.name: Test Failure Analysis
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to identify the cause of failed tests and correct the underlying issue.

roles.description: Develops user-facing web interfaces and client-side applications.

competencies.name: Web Development
competencies.description: Ability to build functional and maintainable web interfaces.

sub_competencies.name: HTML
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to structure web content using semantic HTML.

sub_competencies.name: CSS
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to style interfaces and create responsive layouts.

sub_competencies.name: JavaScript
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to implement client-side logic and interactive web functionality.

sub_competencies.name: Responsive Design
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to create interfaces that function correctly across different screen sizes and devices.

competencies.name: Frontend Frameworks
competencies.description: Ability to develop applications using modern frontend frameworks and libraries.

sub_competencies.name: Component Architecture
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to design reusable and maintainable UI components.

sub_competencies.name: State Management
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to manage application state and data flow effectively.

sub_competencies.name: API Integration
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to consume backend APIs and correctly handle responses and errors.

competencies.name: User Experience
competencies.description: Ability to create interfaces that are usable, accessible, and intuitive.

sub_competencies.name: Accessibility
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to design interfaces usable by people with different accessibility needs.

sub_competencies.name: Usability
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to design interfaces that are easy to understand and operate.

roles.description: Develops server-side applications, APIs, databases, and backend services.

competencies.name: Backend Programming
competencies.description: Ability to develop reliable server-side software using appropriate programming languages and frameworks.

sub_competencies.name: Server-Side Programming
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to write and maintain code that executes on the server.

sub_competencies.name: Error Handling
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to detect, handle, log, and recover from application errors appropriately.

competencies.name: Database Management
competencies.description: Ability to design, query, maintain, and optimize application databases.

sub_competencies.name: SQL
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to write and understand SQL queries for retrieving and modifying data.

sub_competencies.name: Database Design
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to design tables, relationships, schemas, and constraints appropriately.

sub_competencies.name: Indexing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to select and use database indexes appropriately to improve query performance.

sub_competencies.name: Query Optimization
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to identify inefficient queries and improve database performance.

sub_competencies.name: Database Transactions
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding and application of transaction concepts including atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability.

competencies.name: API Development
competencies.description: Ability to design, implement, secure, test, and maintain application programming interfaces.

sub_competencies.name: REST API
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to design and implement RESTful APIs using appropriate HTTP methods and status codes.

sub_competencies.name: API Validation
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to validate incoming API data and reject invalid or unsafe requests.

sub_competencies.name: API Documentation
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to clearly document API endpoints, parameters, responses, and usage.

competencies.name: Backend Security
competencies.description: Ability to protect backend systems, APIs, and data against common security threats.

sub_competencies.name: Authentication
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to securely verify the identity of users or services.

sub_competencies.name: Authorization
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to control access to resources based on user roles or permissions.

sub_competencies.name: Secure Coding
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to avoid common vulnerabilities such as injection, insecure input handling, and improper access control.

roles.description: Collects, cleans, analyses, visualizes, and interprets data to support decisions.

competencies.name: Data Processing
competencies.description: Ability to prepare raw data for reliable analysis.

sub_competencies.name: Data Cleaning
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to identify and correct missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or invalid data.

sub_competencies.name: Data Transformation
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to transform data into appropriate structures and formats for analysis.

competencies.name: Statistics
competencies.description: Ability to apply statistical concepts and methods appropriately.

sub_competencies.name: Descriptive Statistics
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to summarize datasets using measures such as mean, median, variance, and standard deviation.

sub_competencies.name: Probability
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of probability concepts required for statistical analysis.

sub_competencies.name: Statistical Inference
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to draw conclusions about populations using sample data.

competencies.name: Data Visualization
competencies.description: Ability to communicate data insights using appropriate visual representations.

sub_competencies.name: Chart Selection
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to select an appropriate visualization for a particular dataset and analytical purpose.

sub_competencies.name: Dashboard Design
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to create clear and useful dashboards for communicating information.

roles.description: Manages software delivery pipelines, infrastructure, deployment, monitoring, and operational reliability.

competencies.name: CI/CD
competencies.description: Ability to automate software build, testing, and deployment processes.

sub_competencies.name: Continuous Integration
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to automate code integration, building, and testing.

sub_competencies.name: Continuous Deployment
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to automate reliable application deployment.

competencies.name: Containerization
competencies.description: Ability to package and operate applications using container technologies.

sub_competencies.name: Container Management
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to build, configure, run, and manage application containers.

sub_competencies.name: Container Orchestration
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of systems used to deploy and manage containerized workloads at scale.

competencies.name: System Monitoring
competencies.description: Ability to monitor application and infrastructure health and identify operational problems.

sub_competencies.name: Logging
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to collect and interpret application and system logs.

sub_competencies.name: Performance Monitoring
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to monitor resource usage, application performance, and service health.

sub_competencies.name: Incident Response
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to identify, troubleshoot, and respond to operational incidents.

roles.description: Designs, configures, maintains, and troubleshoots computer networks.

competencies.name: Networking Fundamentals
competencies.description: Understanding of fundamental computer networking concepts and protocols.

sub_competencies.name: OSI and TCP/IP Models
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of network layers and how communication occurs across them.

sub_competencies.name: IP Addressing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to understand and configure IPv4/IPv6 addressing and subnetting.

sub_competencies.name: Routing
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding and configuration of network routing between different networks.

competencies.name: Network Security
competencies.description: Ability to protect network infrastructure from unauthorized access and threats.

sub_competencies.name: Firewalls
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to configure and manage firewall rules to control network traffic.

sub_competencies.name: Secure Networking
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to apply secure communication and network protection practices.

competencies.name: Network Troubleshooting
competencies.description: Ability to identify and resolve network connectivity and performance problems.

sub_competencies.name: Connectivity Diagnosis
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to systematically identify the cause of network connectivity problems.

sub_competencies.name: Network Diagnostic Tools
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to use appropriate tools to diagnose network issues.

roles.description: Monitors systems for security threats, investigates incidents, and applies security controls.

competencies.name: Security Fundamentals
competencies.description: Understanding of fundamental cybersecurity concepts, threats, and security controls.

sub_competencies.name: Security Principles
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of confidentiality, integrity, availability, authentication, and authorization.

sub_competencies.name: Common Cyber Threats
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to recognize common threats such as phishing, malware, credential attacks, and unauthorized access.

competencies.name: Security Monitoring
competencies.description: Ability to monitor systems and identify suspicious security events.

sub_competencies.name: Security Log Analysis
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to examine logs and identify suspicious or anomalous activity.

sub_competencies.name: Threat Detection
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to identify indicators of compromise and potential security threats.

competencies.name: Incident Response
competencies.description: Ability to investigate, contain, and respond to cybersecurity incidents.

sub_competencies.name: Incident Identification
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to determine whether observed activity represents a security incident.

sub_competencies.name: Incident Containment
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of appropriate actions to limit the impact of a security incident.

roles.description: Designs, evaluates, maintains, and troubleshoots computer hardware systems and components.

competencies.name: Computer Architecture
competencies.description: Understanding of how computer hardware components interact to execute programs.

sub_competencies.name: CPU Architecture
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of processor components, instruction execution, registers, and basic architecture.

sub_competencies.name: Memory Architecture
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of RAM, cache, memory hierarchy, and memory access.

sub_competencies.name: I/O Architecture
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of communication between processors and peripheral devices.

competencies.name: Hardware Troubleshooting
competencies.description: Ability to diagnose and resolve hardware failures.

sub_competencies.name: Fault Diagnosis
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to systematically identify the source of hardware failures.

sub_competencies.name: Component Testing
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to test individual hardware components to identify faulty parts.

competencies.name: Embedded Systems
competencies.description: Understanding of hardware-software interaction in embedded computing systems.

sub_competencies.name: Microcontrollers
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of microcontroller architecture and basic programming.

sub_competencies.name: Hardware-Software Interface
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding of how software interacts with hardware components and peripherals.

roles.description: Manages operating systems, servers, users, services, and IT infrastructure.

competencies.name: Operating Systems
competencies.description: Ability to administer and troubleshoot operating systems used in organizational infrastructure.

sub_competencies.name: Linux Administration
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to manage Linux users, services, permissions, processes, and system configuration.

sub_competencies.name: Windows Administration
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to manage Windows systems, users, services, policies, and configurations.

competencies.name: System Security
competencies.description: Ability to protect servers and systems from unauthorized access and security threats.

sub_competencies.name: Access Control
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to manage user permissions and restrict access to system resources appropriately.

sub_competencies.name: System Hardening
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to reduce system attack surfaces through secure configuration and unnecessary service removal.

competencies.name: Backup and Recovery
competencies.description: Ability to protect systems and data through appropriate backup and recovery procedures.

sub_competencies.name: Backup Management
sub_competencies.definition: Ability to configure, monitor, and verify system and data backups.

sub_competencies.name: Disaster Recovery
sub_competencies.definition: Understanding and application of procedures for restoring systems after major failures.
